records.context: In situ sequencing modes of the spacer-prefix decode: combinatorial barcodes, peak-prioritised calling and read compartments (item 961, alpha).
records.label: spacr.ops_insitu#0
records.source: In situ sequencing modes of the spacer-prefix decode: combinatorial barcodes, peak-prioritised calling and read compartments (item 961, alpha).
records.translation: Modes de séquençage in situ du décodage par préfixe d'espaceur : codes-barres combinatoires, appels priorisés par pic et compartiments de lecture (élément 961, alpha).

records.context: Pooled screening experiments read with PerturbView, Zombie or T7 in situ sequencing differ in three ways from a screening experiment that reads the guide itself, as the Funk et al. and PERISCOPE screening experiments do, and each is a setting here.
records.label: spacr.ops_insitu#1
records.source: Pooled screens read with PerturbView, Zombie or T7 in situ sequencing differ in three ways from a screen that reads the guide itself, as the Funk et al. and PERISCOPE screens do, and each is a setting here.
records.translation: Les expériences de criblage groupé lues par séquençage in situ PerturbView, Zombie ou T7 diffèrent sur trois points d'une expérience de criblage qui lit le guide lui-même, comme le font les expériences de criblage de Funk et al. et de PERISCOPE, et chaque point est ici un réglage.

records.context: A cell's identity can be a combination of barcode segments read in different cycles (``ops_barcode_layout='combinatorial'``). A layout file names each segment's cycles, the library column it is read against and its role: ``map`` segments identify the construct, ``recomb`` segments must pair with the map segment's construct (a read whose segments belong to different constructs is flagged ``recombined`` and not used for the call), and ``umi`` segments are only recorded.
records.label: spacr.ops_insitu#2
records.source: A cell's identity can be a combination of barcode segments read in different cycles (``ops_barcode_layout='combinatorial'``). A layout file names each segment's cycles, the library column it is read against and its role: ``map`` segments identify the construct, ``recomb`` segments must pair with the map segment's construct (a read whose segments belong to different constructs is flagged ``recombined`` and not used for the call), and ``umi`` segments are only recorded.
records.translation: L'identité d'une cellule peut être une combinaison de segments de code-barres lus dans des cycles différents (``ops_barcode_layout='combinatorial'``). Un fichier de disposition indique pour chaque segment ses cycles, la colonne de la bibliothèque à laquelle il est comparé et son rôle : les segments ``map`` identifient le construit, les segments ``recomb`` doivent correspondre au construit du segment map (une lecture dont les segments appartiennent à des construits différents est marquée ``recombined`` et n'est pas utilisée pour l'appel), et les segments ``umi`` sont seulement enregistrés.

records.context: One bright amplicon per cell is better called by peak intensity than by read count (``ops_call_sort='peak'``; ``'count'`` and ``'quality'`` rank by reads or by mean read quality).
records.label: spacr.ops_insitu#3
records.source: One bright amplicon per cell is better called by peak intensity than by read count (``ops_call_sort='peak'``; ``'count'`` and ``'quality'`` rank by reads or by mean read quality).
records.translation: Un amplicon brillant par cellule est mieux appelé par l'intensité du pic que par le nombre de lectures (``ops_call_sort='peak'`` ; ``'count'`` et ``'quality'`` classent par lectures ou par qualité moyenne des lectures).

records.context: Amplicons that stay in the nucleus are better assigned to the nucleus (``ops_read_compartment='nucleus'``; ``'cytoplasm'`` keeps the reads outside it), from the nucleus labels of ``ops_prefix_nuclei_masks``.
records.label: spacr.ops_insitu#4
records.source: Amplicons that stay in the nucleus are better assigned to the nucleus (``ops_read_compartment='nucleus'``; ``'cytoplasm'`` keeps the reads outside it), from the nucleus labels of ``ops_prefix_nuclei_masks``.
records.translation: Les amplicons qui restent dans le noyau sont mieux attribués au noyau (``ops_read_compartment='nucleus'`` ; ``'cytoplasm'`` garde les lectures en dehors), d'après les étiquettes de noyaux de ``ops_prefix_nuclei_masks``.

records.context: ``ops_insitu_preset='t7'`` sets the T7 combination Brieflow validated: reads assigned to the nucleus, peak-prioritised calling and one read per cell.
records.label: spacr.ops_insitu#5
records.source: ``ops_insitu_preset='t7'`` sets the T7 combination Brieflow validated: reads assigned to the nucleus, peak-prioritised calling and one read per cell.
records.translation: ``ops_insitu_preset='t7'`` fixe la combinaison T7 validée par Brieflow : lectures attribuées au noyau, appels priorisés par pic et une lecture par cellule.

records.context: Every segment is matched with the spacer-prefix decode's own matcher, so there is one matcher. The combinatorial decode reports, per segment, the mapping rate, the decoy FDR of the map segment and the barcode-shuffle call rate (every segment's whitelist shuffled together), and per cell the unique combination rate and the recombination rate. With every setting at its default the spacer-prefix decode is unchanged.
records.label: spacr.ops_insitu#6
records.source: Every segment is matched with the spacer-prefix decode's own matcher, so there is one matcher. The combinatorial decode reports, per segment, the mapping rate, the decoy FDR of the map segment and the barcode-shuffle call rate (every segment's whitelist shuffled together), and per cell the unique combination rate and the recombination rate. With every setting at its default the spacer-prefix decode is unchanged.
records.translation: Chaque segment est apparié par le propre comparateur du décodage par préfixe d'espaceur, il n'y a donc qu'un comparateur. Le décodage combinatoire indique, par segment, le taux d'appariement, la FDR des leurres du segment map et le taux d'appels avec barcodes mélangés (les listes blanches de tous les segments mélangées ensemble), et par cellule le taux de combinaisons uniques et le taux de recombinaison. Avec chaque réglage à sa valeur par défaut, le décodage par préfixe d'espaceur est inchangé.
